talents.name: Toughness
talents.description: Increases your armor value from items by 2/4/6/8/10% (per rank).

talents.name: Redoubt
talents.description: Damaging melee attacks have a 10% chance to increase your block chance by 6/12/18/24/30% for 10 sec or 5 blocks. Unlocks Shield Specialization.

talents.name: Precision
talents.description: Improves your chance to hit by 1/2/3%. Requires 5 points.

talents.name: Guardian's Favor
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Protection by 1/2 min and increases the duration of Blessing of Freedom by 3/6 sec. Requires 5 points.

talents.name: Anticipation
talents.description: Increases your Defense skill by 4/8/12/16/20. Requires 5 points.

talents.name: Improved Seal of Fury
talents.description: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restores Mana (more per attacker level above you, up to 45%). Unlocks Swift Judgement. Requires 10 points.

talents.name: Improved Righteous Fury
talents.description: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by 2/4/6%. Requires 10 points.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
talents.description: Increases damage absorbed by your shield by 10/20/30%, and blocks have a 33/66/100% chance to restore 6% of maximum Mana (once per 3 sec). Requires Redoubt maxed + 10 points.

talents.name: Sacred Duty
talents.description: Increases total Stamina by 2/4% and reduces the cooldown of Divine Shield, Divine Protection and Templar's Bulwark by 30/60 sec. Requires 10 points.

talents.name: Swift Judgement
talents.description: Instant, 1 min cooldown. Finishes the remaining cooldown on Judgement and makes the next one cost 100% less Mana. Requires Improved Seal of Fury + 15 points.

talents.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
talents.description: Increases damage with one-handed melee weapons by 3/7/10%. Requires 15 points.

talents.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Hammer of Justice by 5/10/15 sec. Requires 15 points.

talents.name: Templar's Bulwark
talents.description: 110 Mana, Instant, 5 min cooldown. Absorb shield equal to 100% of maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Gold talent (~21 pts). Requires 20 points.

talents.name: Reckoning
talents.description: 8/16/24/32/40% chance for an extra attack after blocking, plus 20/40/60/80/100% after suffering a non-periodic critical strike. Requires 20 points.

talents.name: Iron Creed
talents.description: Holy Strike generates 5/10/15/20/25% more threat; under Righteous Fury it also reduces damage taken by 2/4/6/8/10% for 6 sec. Requires 25 points.

talents.name: Holy Shield
talents.description: 150 Mana, Instant, 10 sec cooldown. +20% block for 10 sec, 110 Holy damage per block (+20% threat), 4 charges. Requires Shields. Capstone (~31 pts). Requires Templar's Bulwark + 30 points.
